title: A Perturbation-Correction Method Based on Local Randomized Neural Networks for Quasi-Linear Interface Problems
summary: For quasi-linear elliptic interface problems with discontinuous diffusion coefficients, randomized neural network approximations may exhibit stagnation because the associated objective functional is generally nonconvex. This paper proposes a Local Randomized Neural Network (LRaNN) perturbation-correction method, denoted by LRaNN-PC, to alleviate this stagnation. The method represents the solution using an LRaNN on each subdomain, coupled through the interface conditions in a domain-decomposed framework.
